The D CORE 2U 19in X20RM Industrial Server Rack Mount Black Case is a professional-grade rackmount chassis designed for high-performance server, networking, and storage systems. Built to fit standard 19-inch server racks, this compact 2U rack mount case provides a space-efficient solution for data centers, ISP infrastructure, surveillance systems, and enterprise IT environments.


Constructed with heavy-duty industrial steel, the X20RM rackmount chassis ensures durability and long-term reliability in continuous operation environments. Its robust structure supports multiple server components while maintaining efficient airflow for stable system performance. The sleek black industrial finish provides a professional look suitable for modern server rooms and network cabinets.


The D CORE X20RM rackmount case supports a variety of motherboard form factors including Micro-ATX and Mini-ITX, along with standard ATX power supplies, making it ideal for building servers, NAS storage, NVR systems, firewalls, or industrial PCs. With multiple expansion slots and storage options, it offers excellent flexibility for enterprise and networking deployments.


Designed for professional IT infrastructure, the D CORE 2U 19-inch rackmount server case delivers reliability, scalability, and efficient rack space utilization—making it a perfect choice for businesses and system integrators in Bangladesh.
